current_checkpoint.name: Fender Tone Master Pro Dynamic Delay timing, filters, and modulation

official_source.title: Tone Master Pro Model Guide
official_source.revision: v1.1.100 / Rev. A, printed p. 45; firmware page checked through v1.8.85 (2026-11-18).
official_source.qualification: The guide names Dynamic Delay controls. Firmware v1.6.34 is the latest checked source here to state a Time range of 30–2,000 ms; the other numeric ranges/defaults and any unit-installed firmware remain unknown.

current_checkpoint.documented_controls: Time, Feedback, Mix, Tap Division, repeat Low Cut and High Cut, Threshold, Attenuation, Release, Mod Rate, Mod Depth, Mod Mode (SINE/TRI/RAND/TRIG), and Spillover Switch.
current_checkpoint.project_controls: The project-authored Ducking Delay retains Free Time with 20–300 BPM Tempo Sync and 14 divisions; repeat Low/High Cut are in the feedback path; block-bypass Spillover is optional. Defaults remain 350 ms Time, 0.25 Feedback/Mix, −30 dB Threshold, 12 dB Attenuation, 250 ms Release, 0.8 Hz Mod Rate, 0 ms Mod Depth, and Sine mode. Project modulation modes are Sine/Triangle/Random/Triggered Ramp; rate is 0.05–10 Hz, depth 0–50 ms and capped by available delay headroom. Triggered Ramp resets on the existing threshold crossing and rearms below threshold. All numeric ranges, defaults, division choices, filtering, and DSP are project choices. Preset/scene transition tails are not implemented.

verification.native_ctest: make test passed 102/102 CTest cases, including Ducking Delay timing, feedback-cut, ducking, spillover, stereo, bounds, and finite-input tests.
verification.browser: make web-browser-test passed the 73-active-stage browser/native comparison at 48 kHz; max absolute error 0.00000668335, RMS error 0.00000121755. Local prerecorded Guitar-TECHS DI Play at Delay index 39 used 120 BPM/eighth, cuts 150/7,000 Hz, and 1.25 Hz/6.5 ms Sine modulation; peak 0.0614053, 71,430 active samples, difference RMS 0.0138586.
verification.wasm_memory: Fixed 96 MiB heap; processor state 78,988,648 B plus 10,364 B tuner state.
verification.isolated_benchmark: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, Release, 48 kHz stereo/128 frames, 2,000 warm-up and 5,000 measured blocks. Ducking Delay default p50/p95/p99/p99.9/max 0.1331/0.1335/0.1797/1.7003/2.8043%; feedback cuts 150/7,000 Hz plus 1.25 Hz/6.5 ms Sine modulation 0.1823/0.1838/0.2355/1.6733/1.7640% of the 2.667 ms callback deadline. Both configurations own 768,296 B; process() allocates nothing.
verification.windows: make windows-cross-build passed for the native core and offline renderer with Ducking Delay.
verification.notes: Automated implementation verified; project-authored controls/DSP, with no Fender algorithm/settings/sound parity. Browser/native and desktop processor measurements do not establish live round-trip latency. Human listening and hardware checks remain open.
